title: Finding inspiration and creativity during difficult times
en: have you felt sad recently over time I've learned to take the feeling as it comes accepting it like a wave rising and falling there isn't always a solution as for me I find comfort in nature and in spraying my spirit particularly yearns for flowers blue flax blooms just outside my front door and it is one of my favorite flowers of the season one day when I needed to raise my spirits I picked a bouquet to bring home so to inspire my creativity you yeah just like that I felt better

my soul arrested my mind at peace we are living in such a crazy time right now and I know it is very upsetting and very difficult for so many people myself included there are times this year that I have found myself worrying about the future and for humankind and is always worrying about the planet sometimes it becomes too much to bear and I find that that is the most important time to go outside and take a walk it's something so simple and yet I find again and again that it's the answer I need you have no control over the actions of others and I think that is the root of a lot of the anger that people feel right now I've accepted that I cannot control the spirit of someone else however every time that I feel frustrated about the actions of others I know that the one thing that I can control is my own spirit and that I have complete control over that and that is liberating I think it's also such an important message for everyone to hear that you have at anytime of the potential to become someone you are

proud of someone who is kind and courageous someone who is compassionate we can become that person I wasn't always the person that I most admired and now I am and I'm very proud to say that I'll tell you one thought that I found really comforting and it is if at the end of your journey your life journey all you can say that you have achieved is a life that has been lived by kindness and compassion then you have lived one of the best lives of all time thank you guys so much for watching this video my intention was not to make a sad video and I hope it is not sad to you my intent Jim was to share a little bit of the words that I say to myself that make me continue feeling hopeful and fighting despair so thank you all
zh: 最近你是否感到悲伤 随着时间的推移，我学会了接受这种感觉，就像波浪起伏一样接受它，对我来说，我在大自然中找到安慰，在喷洒我的精神时，特别渴望在我前门外绽放的蓝色亚麻花，它是我这个季节最喜欢的花之一，有一天，当我需要振奋精神时，我选了一束花带回家，以激发我的创造力，是的，就像这样，我感觉好多了

我的灵魂平静地束缚了我的思想，我们现在生活在一个如此疯狂的时代，我知道这对很多人来说非常令人沮丧和困难，包括我自己，今年有时我发现自己担心未来和人类，总是担心这个星球，有时它变得难以承受，我发现这是最重要的时间出去散步，这是如此简单的事情，但我一次又一次发现这就是我需要的答案，你无法控制别人的行为，我我认为这是人们现在感到的很多愤怒的根源，我已经接受了我无法控制别人的精神，但是每当我对其他人的行为感到沮丧时，我知道我可以控制的一件事就是我自己的精神，并且我可以完全控制它，这就是解放我认为这对每个人来说也是一个非常重要的信息，让每个人听到你随时都有潜力成为你现在的样子

为善良而勇敢的人感到自豪 富有同情心的人 我们可以成为这样的人 我并不总是我最钦佩的人，现在我是，我很自豪地说，我会告诉你一个我觉得真正令人安慰的想法，那就是，如果在你的旅程结束时，你的人生旅程你所能说的就是你所取得的成就是一种靠善良和同情心过的生活，那么你就过着有史以来最好的生活之一，非常感谢你们观看这个视频，我的目的不是要让一个悲伤的视频，我希望你不会悲伤，我的目的吉姆是想分享一些我对自己说的话，让我继续充满希望并与绝望作斗争，所以谢谢大家
